title: Ɗan leƙen asiri mai gashin fuka-fukai
intro: A cikin mulkin da aka ba wa wanda aka ba shi iko a kan iskoki, halittun da ba a gani, da halittun sama, wani ƙaramin memba mai sauri ya ɓace daga sahun gaba - sai kawai ya dawo da wahayi wanda zai sake fasalin makomar wata ƙasa mai nisa. Wannan mai ba da labari mai ido ya bayyana gaskiya inda jahilci ya fara tushe. Wanene ni?
clues: Na yi hidima a kotu inda mutane, halittu marasa ganuwa, da halittun sama suke amsa ga wani mai mulki mai hikima wanda ke jagorantar iska.
Na ɗan lokaci ban je wurin aikina ba, kuma an yi alƙawarin fushin mai mulki idan na kasa bayar da dalili mai gamsarwa.
Ni ƙaramin halitta ne mai gudu, an san ni da gani mai kaifi, kuma an girmama irina da suna kai tsaye a shafukan wahayi.
Da na dawo, na kawo labarin wata ƙasa mai nisa inda mutane suka yi sujada ga rana, suna makantar da wanda ya halicci sammai da ƙasa.
Na sami wata mace tana mulki a kan wata babbar masarauta, tana zaune a kan wani babban kursiyi, ba ta taɓa sanin gaskiya ba a da.
Ni ne wanda ya gano daular Saba' kuma ya ɗauki wasiƙar gayyata daga wani annabi-sarki wanda aka ba shi iko a kan iska.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Bilqis ya gabatar da kansa a gaban kotun Sulaiman
Fir'auna da rundunarsa sun nutse a cikin teku
Mutanen Adawa sun halaka da iska mai ƙarfi
Masu sihirin Fir'auna sun yi imani da Annabi Musa
Ambaliyar ruwa mai yawa ta cinye kafirai
outcome.answer: Bilqis ya gabatar da kansa a gaban kotun Sulaiman

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
